name: app-wellness-engagement-flow-with-floating-cards-and-dashed-path
title: Wellness hub engagement story with floating reminder cards on a lilac field and dashed path
whatItIs: A long pale lilac board with a 'Solving UX' pill, a title, challenge and solution notes tilted at angles, two hand-held indigo phones in rounded squares, an icon nav pill, blurred reminder cards (medication, walk the dog, meal), a tote bag with a quote and a mood card, all linked by a dashed winding path.
whatItMeans: Soft and human; scattered blurry cards convey a day of gentle prompts.
techniques: Scatter UI cards and photos along a dashed path.
Blur cards at the edges to imply depth.
Tilt notes slightly like pinned papers.
Use one indigo with a yellow accent.

vocabulary.definition: A small card representing a notification.
Items connected by a dashed line telling a story.
Blurring outer elements to imply distance.
A note card rotated for casualness.
